title: AI data centers drive Taiwan's electrical firms into modular, EPC markets
summary: As demand for AI data centers expands, next-generation AI servers are raising requirements for power supply, cooling efficiency, and deployment speed. title: Meta’s AI commitments surge to US$825 billion, testing financing power

summary: Texas Instruments (TI) held its latest earnings call this week, projecting fourth-quarter 2026 revenue of US$5.8 billion to US$6.3 billion. The midpoint of its guidance is broadly in line with third-quarter revenue, outperforming the seasonal declines typically seen in the fourth quarter.

title: Column: Will general-purpose models overtake Physical AI?
summary: After GPT-6 Astra launched in early September 2026, researchers quickly put it through Physical AI and robotics benchmarks. In some tests, it outperformed specialized models trained on large amounts of robot data.

title: Magnate Technology sees aerospace, semiconductor growth opportunities
summary: Magnate Technology expects rising aircraft engine demand and semiconductor equipment opportunities to support growth as it expands production capacity, with implications for global aviation and chip supply chains. title: Moonshot's Singapore hiring shows how China's open-model labs plan to get paid abroad

title: Interview: The story of LEACHIM, a working humanoid robot from the 1970s
summary: The robotics industry has come a long way since robots were first built over 50 years ago. title: Nvidia rejects near-term memory glut fears, leaves CXMT cooperation open
